model: Black-Scholes-Merton: one underlying, constant continuously compounded rate, constant continuous dividend yield, constant volatility, European exercise

conventions.price: present value in the same currency units as spot and strike
conventions.vega: dV/dsigma, per 1.00 of volatility (NOT per volatility point)
conventions.theta: dV/dt, per year (negative for a long position that decays)
conventions.rho: dV/dr, per 1.00 of the continuously compounded rate (NOT per basis point)
conventions.dividend_rho: dV/dq, per 1.00 of the continuously compounded dividend yield
conventions.expiry_years: year fraction under Actual/365 Fixed; exactly expiry_days / 365
conventions.note: Raw partial derivatives as QuantLib returns them. No market scaling is applied: a per-day theta or a per-point vega would put a convention factor inside the oracle, where an arithmetic identity belongs. Scale at the point of display.

tolerances.note: Relative where the reference exceeds 1.0, absolute otherwise. The edge block is looser by construction, not by concession: see SCHEMA.md.
